source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 1. Bios Setting EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> Lock Chipset -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> MSR Lock Control -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> EV DFX features -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> Disable BIOS Done -> [‘X’] EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> WHEA Error Injection Support -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> Whea PCIE Error Injection Action Table -> Enabled 2. Deploy Intel ITP environment. 3. Boot SUT into Windows. 4. Execute Intel Cscripts on the client 5. Using the following command >>>itp.log("C:\Test.log") >>>halt() >>>pcie.topology() >>>pcie.port_map() 6. Check PCIe slot target >>>ei.injectPcieError(socket, port, errType='ce',) >>>go 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. System should work normally 2. BMC error log may record pcie correctable error 3. Front Panel fault Light will not Light if there is one 4. uEFI SEL Log may record pcie correctable error if there is one
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- OCP slot 1~N (Intel correctable ECC on OCP slot 1~N error injection): requires CScripts/EDKII unlock (Lock Chipset=Disable, MSR Lock Control=Disable, EV DFX Features=Enable, WHEA Error Injection Support=Enable) + the user/FAE to drive the Cscript/error-injection harness for this exact pattern. Agent captures the post-injection evidence with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -180 | grep -iE 'corrected|CE_|CE |EDAC|memory.error'; echo __correctable_ECC_on_OCP_slot_1~N; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1".

test_case.purpose: Inject one correctable PCIe error into every approved OCP slot/root port and prove the expected AER/WHEA CE occurs while the OCP device, network link and system remain operational and fault indicators stay off.
required_package: OCP slot/function to endpoint/root-port BDF and Cscript socket/port map
OCP NIC/device PN/FW/driver, interface/bond/route/VLAN and management-path dependency
Mandatory Windows PCIe CE plus link/traffic/device-health and applicable BMC/UEFI oracle
OOB console, abort, recovery and BIOS restoration plan
test_case.test_command: Map each OCP physical slot and function through endpoint/root-port BDF to the Cscript socket/port, identify management and active traffic dependencies, quiesce or select a safe test window, perform one CE injection, and correlate Cscript/Windows PCIe evidence with link, traffic, driver and applicable management logs before restoration.
test_case.expected_result: 1. System should work normally 2. BMC error log may record pcie correctable error 3. Front Panel fault Light will not Light if there is one 4. uEFI SEL Log may record pcie correctable error if there is one

safety_gate: Prove an independent management path before any OCP target action
Quiesce production traffic or approve a bounded maintenance window
Use a fresh topology map and inject one approved function/root port
Abort on connectivity loss, link retrain/down, device reset, fatal escalation or wrong target

expected_evidence: OCP slot/function/endpoint/root-port/Cscript mapping and owner approval
NIC/device identity, FW/driver and network-path precheck
Package hash and full topology/injection transcript
